title: Transcode status poller and its tests
name: Transcode status poller

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in these tests that could make any of them pass on some runs and fail on others? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
With maxPolls 4 and a job that never leaves "transcoding", how long does waitForRenditions spend sleeping in production (realSleeper, intervalMs 2000)?
choices: 0 seconds; it throws on the first poll

questions.prompt: ScriptedTranscoder is given the script ["transcoding"] and polled 4 times. What state does it return on the 4th call?
choices: undefined, because the index is past the end of the script
"transcoding", because the index is clamped to the last script entry

questions.prompt: What is the main benefit of passing a Sleeper into waitForRenditions instead of calling setTimeout directly?
choices: It lets the tests run instantly and assert on the exact delays requested, with no dependence on wall-clock timing
It makes production polling more accurate than setTimeout
It allows several jobs to be polled in parallel
It lets the caller cancel a poll in progress
